description: This file defines the ServerRequestFactory class in the Slim Framework, responsible for creating PSR-7 server request objects, either from parameters or from PHP globals.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing PSR-17 ServerRequestFactoryInterface to create ServerRequest instances from parameters or PHP globals.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates an instance of ServerRequestInterface with specified method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object based on current PHP global variables, including request method, URI, headers, cookies, and body.
